title: Hot Jamaican Tuna Pie
description: A spicy, gooey midnight craving dish featuring tuna and lamination-puff, diabetic-friendly and made in a kadhai.
instructions: Heat the kadhai with one tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and finely chopped scotch bonnet pepper, sautéing until fragrant.
Stir in one teaspoon of ginger, one teaspoon of allspice, and two tablespoons of tomato paste, cooking for one minute.
Add the drained canned tuna to the mixture and cook for two minutes, then season with one teaspoon of salt and one half teaspoon of black pepper.
Fold in one tablespoon of chopped cilantro and mix thoroughly.
Set the tuna mixture aside to cool slightly.
Roll out the puff pastry sheets on a lightly floured surface and cut into four equal squares.
Place a spoonful of tuna filling on the center of each pastry square, fold the edges over, and seal with a fork.
Arrange the folded pastries on a greased baking pan, brush the tops with a beaten egg for shine.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for fifteen minutes until the pastry is golden and crisp.
Remove from oven, let sit one minute, then serve hot.
Enjoy the spicy, gooey tuna pies while they are still warm.
